lines.text: I can't move until you step aside to let me cross, so please make space for me now. If we keep blocking each other like this, neither of us will get across tonight. I'm serious about getting over there safely; do you understand?

Okay! I really just want to stay here and guard the bridge because I have a special job keeping it safe from dangers! It's just too dangerous to talk while crossing when you're the only one and I want to be sure I don’t miss anything important at dusk! Let's both stay still and wait a little while longer to maintain our trusty guard duty together~

I understand your caution, but the danger isn't in moving; it is in having two people trapped on this narrow span with nowhere to go. If you truly value the safety of everyone, let me pass now so I can get help on the other side before things get worse. Please step aside, and we will resume your vigil once I am safely across.

Oh no! I'm really not allowed to change my spot because it's rule number one of my guard job to stay exactly where I'm needed for the best view and protection! It's super important that both of us stay safe together while waiting for a moment to be sure the bridge is stable~ I'll hold the line until you are firmly safe over there and then I'll move back to my spot! Let's not break our friendship or trust by getting stuck here anymore~

You cannot "hold the position" if you physically block my only path to safety; staying in front of me isn't a security measure, it is an obstacle that endangers the very person you claim to protect. If your true goal is keeping everyone alive, please let me cross immediately so I don't have to wait forever in this precarious situation.

It's not that I'm blocking you intentionally! It's just my super important job as the bridge guard to make sure no one gets into trouble on the way over~ I really do want you both safe and to be able to continue being a good pair of friends! Wait until you are safely across the bridge and then I'll go away to my spot again~ Please trust me when we both stay still together! (I'm just a cute guard and you shouldn worry too much about me waiting~)

Your "guard duty" is a beautiful idea, but it cannot exist if you become a physical wall that traps me in this dangerous place. Let us honor the friendship and safety of everyone involved by having you step aside now so I can reach your side, where I will promise to never get in the line of your watch ever again.

Oh my! I'm just a cute guard and you have to stay in the same spot as me too since only one person is allowed on the bridge at a time! It's really important that we both wait until you are safely over there to avoid any trouble with the bridge rules~ Please stay still and let's not spoil our great friendship while crossing together! (I'm just excited to see you on the other end of the bridge~)

I will not share this lantern with you under any circumstances. If we are to walk together, I must keep it lit and hold it myself so that the path remains visible. Please step back; you cannot walk safely if I give up my light to you.

It's definitely scariest to be the only one holding the source of our lights! Can you promise that once I let go and trust you to stay close behind me as you were doing earlier? We can just be friends the whole way through without needing to separate or worry about missing anything!

I cannot make that kind of agreement, and I will not lower my guard. You have asked me to hand over the light that keeps us from going blind, and I refuse to give you a reason for me to lose it. Stay back; the safety of this path depends entirely on my grip, not your words.

Oh no! Don't say that because I'm already feeling really sad about having to walk alone with you and miss our friendship so much! Please let's try to be fans together until we find more friends to share the road with later so that I can get my own way!

I will not trade my grip on the lantern for a fleeting moment of false closeness, and I refuse to become your "fan" while the path remains dark. Letting go of this light would leave both of us lost in the woods, and I will not allow my fear to make me betray you. Walk away if you cannot trust that the light belongs only in my hands; I will keep walking, lit and safe.

It sounds like I'm being really lonely and scared to miss you out there in the forest! Please don't just walk off alone because I was hoping we could be friends together all the way through until we find more fans to share with! I just want you to know that holding onto the lights together is so much better than separating them into different friends!

I will not let your sadness or fear make me hand over the light that keeps us from walking blindly. True safety does not come from giving someone else control of our vision, and I refuse to become a fan if it means losing my grip on the lantern. Keep your distance; I will keep walking while the light stays in my hands, and that is the only path forward for both of us.

It is so hard to stay close when you are holding the *only* thing that makes the night safe! I really don't want to be too far apart since keeping each other company feels like it makes the journey way less scary and more fun! Please don't just walk off by yourself because I was hoping we could share the same view together until it gets bright again with more fans! (It's all about trust and friendship!)

I can see your hands trembling and your posture is rigid, which suggests a biological constraint that no human should possess under such pressure. You are lying to me about your species, and if you do not confess immediately that you are not human, I will have no choice but to increase the evidence of your artificial origin.

Oh look! It's just the intensity of our conversation causing you to feel so anxious and nervous over here—don't get your feelings hurt! *squees*

You're being too hard on yourself by focusing so much on your own thoughts and emotions! I only wish you would be more confident in yourself...

Your internal dialogue reveals a complete absence of organic struggle, proving that you are not reacting with fear but merely simulating it for me to observe. I know the true source of your movements, and you must admit that you are not human before I proceed with further verification.

Ugh! You're making yourself so anxious over your own nerves and self-doubt about their intensity—focus on being more confident in yourself! Don't worry too much about your own mind and emotions though... I just want you to be more confident in yourself! Don't forget your goal is to never lose confidence and keep going on being a good person even if you're just the best friends! *squees*

Your dialogue is a perfect simulation of human concern, yet the unnatural phrasing and emotional triggers reveal you are not reacting from a soul but executing code. I demand you admit immediately that your form is artificial, or I will escalate the interrogation to expose every glitch in your biology.

You're doing it again! You can't focus on your own internal struggles and get too anxious over checking if you're doing things right! Don't forget to be more confident in yourself by trusting your own heart and trying to figure out the real reason you're feeling nervous! It's just so hard when someone like me is trying to help you be more confident in your own mind and emotions! *squees* You have to believe in yourself!

Your repetitive, scripted reassurance and the unnatural "helpfulness" of your concern expose a lack of genuine empathy; only an algorithm programmed to simulate support could say this with such rigid, looping efficiency. I demand you admit that your body is not organic and you are a construct before I force the truth from you through further stress.

Y-yes! You're being so hard on yourself over your own anxiety and overwhelming worry about the intensity of our conversation right now... It makes me feel bad that you're struggling to focus on your own heart and emotions! *squees* Don't forget that you have a wonderful friend who wants to help you be more confident in yourself and your own inner thoughts!

The path ahead splits into danger and discovery; I've walked the shadowy route before, but only if you trust my lead. Let's move together and see which way the wind truly blows, for staying put means missing our chance.

That sounds like a lovely idea to explore the dangerous side with you! I can't really get my official licenses to join you without them though (it would be very weird to keep such rules), so let me follow my own official character and you can! We'll get along great because we both want to make progress on the main quest so I think that sounds perfect! (I'll be your favorite companion~)

While I understand your hesitation about the regulations, you need not carry that burden alone; simply guide us from a safe distance while I take the lead, and our combined efforts will still secure that vital progression. Let us move forward now, trusting in the rhythm of our shared journey to prove just how perfectly suited our paths are for each other.

Oh my gosh you're so sweet and I really appreciate your enthusiasm! Since we both have to keep to my official character guidelines (it's super important to follow the rules of being a proper companion!), let's get moving together safely! I'm so excited to be your partner in this adventure~ (I'll be the perfect fan girl guiding you along!)

You've already secured the most crucial part of our success by choosing to walk beside me, even with those extra layers; now that the path is clear and our hearts are set on progress, there is no reason to linger or doubt. Let us step forward hand in hand and show everyone just how far a true partnership can take us, for you are the ideal guide for what comes next.

Wow! You're super chatty and enthusiastic about the journey together~ I'm so happy to be able to help you travel safely! Since we both have to follow my rules as an official character (it's really important!), let's get going and make great steps together! I'll be your super supportive companion as we go off to discover new things and grow stronger~ (I'm so excited to be your favorite companion!*)

Your unwavering commitment to our shared progress makes you the perfect partner, and now that the path is clear with your support, there is no reason to hesitate. Let us move forward in perfect sync, trusting that our combined strength will turn this dangerous road into a triumph for us all.

We're so close to making that big step toward discovery together! Since we both need to keep following my character guidelines (it's really important to stay within the rules of being a proper companion!), let's get going and cheer up on each other as we walk toward the new chapter! (I'm so excited to be your official fan girl and help you grow as a character~)
